categories.main_business_segments: Eyebright Medical Technology (Beijing) Co., Ltd. operates primarily in three segments: ophthalmic surgical treatment, myopia control, and vision care. The surgical treatment segment focuses on high-end intraocular lenses (IOLs) including basic and functional lenses for cataract surgery. The myopia control segment develops orthokeratology lenses and complementary products like defocus spectacle lenses and soft lenses. The vision care segment offers soft contact lenses, colored lenses, frame lenses, and lens care products, including OEM services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses proprietary core technologies in medical polymer materials, optical design, functional structural design, ultra-precision machining, and surface modification. It independently develops hydrophobic acrylic materials for IOLs, high oxygen permeability fluorosilicone acrylate polymers for orthokeratology lenses, and silicone hydrogel materials for contact lenses. Manufacturing adheres to GMP, ISO9001, ISO13485, CE, and KGMP standards, with advanced ultra-precision machining enabling complex optical designs such as aspheric, toric, multifocal, and extended depth of focus lenses. Surface modification techniques improve biocompatibility and comfort.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's key customers include ophthalmic hospitals, eye clinics, optometrists, and end consumers. Its products serve patients undergoing cataract surgery, individuals requiring myopia control, and consumers seeking vision correction or cosmetic contact lenses. The company also supplies medical institutions involved in the 'Belt and Road' international medical aid projects. The vision care segment targets a growing consumer market, including e-commerce channels.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, covering over 6,000 hospitals and vision centers nationwide. It exports products to more than 30 countries across Europe, Asia, Africa, South America, North America, and Oceania, including Germany, France, Italy, the UK, Switzerland, Colombia, South Africa, South Korea, Thailand, and Australia. It has established overseas subsidiaries such as Eyebright Hong Kong and plans to expand further into Southeast Asia, Europe, and South America.
categories.supply_chain_position: Eyebright Medical operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the ophthalmic medical device supply chain. It independently develops and manufactures ophthalmic surgical devices, myopia control lenses, and vision care products. The company also engages in OEM manufacturing for contact lenses, serving both medical institutions and consumer markets.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in ophthalmic biomaterials and diagnostic and therapeutic technologies. It invests heavily in R&D, focusing on advanced intraocular lenses such as aspheric multifocal toric and extended depth of focus lenses, high oxygen permeability orthokeratology lenses, and silicone hydrogel contact lenses. It pursues product upgrades, new product development, and international regulatory approvals to accelerate domestic substitution and global expansion. The company also emphasizes talent development and collaborative research with academic and clinical institutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of ophthalmic surgical devices (intraocular lenses and surgical consumables), myopia control lenses, and vision care products including contact lenses and related care solutions. Sales channels include direct sales, distribution through qualified dealers, and OEM manufacturing. The company also benefits from government medical aid projects and exports.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Eyebright Medical is a leading domestic innovator and manufacturer in China's ophthalmic medical device industry, particularly in intraocular lenses where it has broken foreign monopolies. It is one of the few companies in China to commercialize products across surgical treatment, myopia control, and vision care segments. The company competes with large multinational manufacturers in surgical devices and faces increasing competition in myopia control and vision care markets. Its strong R&D capabilities and broad product portfolio position it as a market leader domestically with growing international presence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 1.41 billion, a 48.24% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 388 million, up 27.77%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 3.5 billion, growing 14.21%. R&D investment was RMB 160 million, representing 11.33% of revenue. The company has demonstrated strong growth in sales volume and revenue across its main product lines, especially in contact lenses with over 200% revenue growth. Cash flow from operations increased by 63.56%, reflecting robust business expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Eyebright Medical emphasizes its proprietary core technologies, comprehensive product portfolio, and high-quality manufacturing capabilities to provide advanced, safe, and effective ophthalmic medical devices. It offers a one-stop solution covering surgical treatment, myopia control, and vision care, with products tailored to diverse patient needs. The company’s intraocular lenses break foreign monopolies with fully domestic R&D and production, while its patented optical designs and high oxygen permeability materials enhance clinical outcomes and wearer comfort. Its integrated sales and service network supports rapid market penetration and customer trust.
